params.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64
params.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number + {i} * {rows} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})

description: Three parts on both replicas; Cluster.stop(2); small-inserts on r1 at scale 0.5 (500 inserts of 1 000 rows over 600 s, merges on); r1 quiet for 30 s; Cluster.start(2); the window ends when r2 has caught up. One repeat: the case runs over 11 minutes.
